title: Md. Code Ann., Cts. & Jud. Proc. § 5-101 — Three year limitation
citation: Md. Code Ann., Cts. & Jud. Proc. § 5-101
content:
Md. Code Ann., Cts. & Jud. Proc. § 5-101

(a) A civil action at law shall be filed within three years from the date it accrues unless another, shorter statute of limitations applies.

title: Md. Code Ann., Com. Law § 2-725 — Statute of limitations in contracts for sale
content:
Md. Code Ann., Com. Law § 2-725

(1) An action for breach of any contract for sale must be commenced within 4 years after the cause of action has accrued. By the original agreement the parties may reduce the period of limitation to not less than 1 year but may not extend it.

title: Poole v. Co-Operative Supply Co., 532 A.2d 683 (Md. 1987)
content:
Poole v. Co-Operative Supply Co., 532 A.2d 683 (Md. 1987).

[Excerpt — holding summary.]

The Court of Appeals held that Maryland applies the doctrine of contributory negligence, under which a plaintiff who is even slightly negligent is barred from recovering damages.

opinionParts.content: Maryland applies contributory negligence; a plaintiff who is even slightly negligent is barred from recovering damages.
